result_text:
I fixed the five typo'd default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. I didn't add tests for the new matches. The existing tests I ran (`*Scoping*`, `*Convention*`) pass, and the same patterns were not run against sample `.htm`, `.xml` or `-gradle.js` files.

- **Generated HTML (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the extension group `(html|html|xhtml)` had `html` twice. It is now `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match and `.html` and `.xhtml` still do.
- **.NET `<doc>` XML and `// Generated by` JavaScript:** the path patterns `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js` required a file literally named `.xml` or `.js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`, so `MyAssembly.xml` and `app.js` can match. The content checks are unchanged, so hand-written `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of the generated scope.
- **Gradle JavaScript:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` became `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, which matches `build-gradle.js`. `build.gradle` is covered by its own rule, which I left alone.

The `<doc>` content pattern still has to match the whole line, so `<doc>` indented or followed by other text on its line won't match. I left it as it was.
